name: Piotr Müller - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on public procurement
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report is the European Parliament's opinion, not a new law. It calls on the European Commission to rewrite the EU rules on public procurement — the rules public bodies follow when they buy goods, works and services with public money. It asks for simpler procedures, fewer administrative burdens, better access for small businesses, more weight for quality and social and environmental criteria instead of always choosing the cheapest bid, and stronger tools against unfair competition from companies outside the EU.

**Key points**

- It asks the Commission to propose simpler EU procurement rules, with fewer administrative burdens for public buyers and bidders.
- It wants contracts awarded less on lowest price alone, and more on quality, social and environmental criteria.
- It asks for tighter checks on non-EU bidders, including on abnormally low bids and foreign subsidies.
